s: Some of our collaborations, such as with the target-identifying AI company Zephyr, highlight the potential to validate targets and create therapeutics.

Zephyr Joint Research Agreement In March 2022, we entered into a Joint Research Agreement, or JRA, with Zephyr AI, Inc., or Zephyr, focused on the joint collaboration, identification and validation of certain targets in order to facilitate further research, development and potential commercialization of immunotherapies.
